description: This file defines the DBHealthCheck class, which provides methods to assess and repair the health of database tables, specifically focusing on MySQL databases and their engine types.

classes.name: DBHealthCheck
classes.description: A class for checking database health, particularly for MySQL, and updating table engine types.

methods.name: DBHealthCheck
methods.description: Constructor that initializes database connection and type information.

methods.name: isMySQL
methods.description: Checks if the database type is MySQL.

methods.name: isOracle
methods.description: Checks if the database type is Oracle.

methods.name: isPostgres
methods.description: Checks if the database type is PostgreSQL.

methods.name: isDBHealthy
methods.description: Determines if the database is healthy by checking for unhealthy tables.

methods.name: getUnhealthyTablesList
methods.description: Returns a list of tables that are considered unhealthy based on engine type and naming conventions.

methods.name: updateTableEngineType
methods.description: Updates the engine type of a specific table to the recommended engine.

methods.name: updateAllTablesEngineType
methods.description: Updates all unhealthy tables to the recommended engine type.

methods.name: _mysql_getUnhealthyTables
methods.description: Retrieves a list of MySQL tables that are not using the recommended engine or are sequence tables.

methods.name: _mysql_updateEngineType
methods.description: Changes the engine type of a specific table to the recommended engine.

methods.name: _mysql_updateEngineTypeForAllTables
methods.description: Updates all unhealthy tables to the recommended engine type.
